messages:
Evelyn Park: Beta widgets POC is flaking - they get a handful of /v1/generate successes then 403s. Key in use: beta_widgets_key.
Marco Diaz: Paste a failing curl + response?
Evelyn Park: curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer beta_widgets_key' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-redwood-org: org-900' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","prompt":"test"}'
```
Response: `HTTP/1.1 403 {"error":"Forbidden","message":"org_id mismatch","details":"token_org=org-777 request_org=org-900"}`
Evelyn Park: Also saw 401s earlier and a burst of 429s with retry_after=10. Request id r-ff12e3.
Tess (Support): Likely two issues: key scoped to different org and scope might not include generate. Can you introspect: `GET /v1/admin/keys/beta_widgets_key`?
Evelyn Park: Introspect (sanitized): `{ "key":"beta_widgets_key","org_id":"org-777","scopes":["embeddings.read"] }`
Marco Diaz: Yep - token org != request org and missing `api:generate`. Their harness bootstraps an org header from a config file (org-900).
Tess (Support): Quick unblock options: 1) Create a new key under org-900 with `api:generate`. 2) Remove forced x-redwood-org from client. 3) Use an account-scoped key. Which is fastest?
Evelyn Park: I'll spin a key for org-900 with generate scope.
ops-bot: Note: policy change enforced stricter org header checks on 2026-03-18; mismatches now return 403.
Evelyn Park: New key created -> initial success but after ~25s they saw 429 TooManyRequests; they run 35 parallel workers.
Tess (Support): That's per-key QPS. For a demo we can request a temporary uplift (short window) or advise client-side concurrency limiting + exponential backoff.
Marco Diaz: Customer wants minimal friction. Requesting 24h uplift for account beta-widgets-42. Request id r-ff12e3.
Tess (Support): Please submit the POC uplift form: https://console.redwood.ai/support/poc-uplift with account and requested QPS. I'll tag SRE.
ops-bot: SRE ticket created and monitoring.
Evelyn Park: Uplift approved (24h) and applied at 2209998902. POC finished smoke tests green.
Tess (Support): Follow-ups: attach rotation/runbook for hosted keys and note Dedicated pricing for sustained throughput. I'll drop the runbook in the deal folder and DM pricing.
Marco Diaz: Thanks all, will collect security questionnaire answers and send the invoice for uplift.
Evelyn Park: Closing swarm, will re-open if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:
